estimand: Item-weighted target metric difference, equal-weight mean over the five fixed source winners, relative to the same deployer's p0
intervals: Paired repository-cluster percentile bootstrap, conditional on frozen prompts and source seeds
resampling_unit: repository: all 4080, common multiplicities across prompts and views
scope: Post-hoc analysis of frozen predictions; no target tuning, no new inference, no claim of prospective preregistration
simultaneous_sensitivity: Symmetric maximum standardized bootstrap deviation over 84 macro-F1 group gains (42 groups times 2 views); approximate 95% simultaneous coverage, fixed bootstrap SD, not nested studentization
source_seed_sensitivity: Observed five seed effects and leave-one-seed-out means; descriptive only
